description: This file defines the StreamWrapper class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, which provides functionality to convert Guzzle streams into PHP stream resources and implements a stream wrapper for custom handling of Guzzle streams.

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: A class that provides a PHP stream wrapper implementation for Guzzle streams, allowing them to be used as native PHP stream resources.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Creates and returns a PHP stream resource for the given Guzzle StreamInterface, registering the stream wrapper if necessary.

methods.name: createStreamContext
methods.description: Creates a stream context array that encapsulates the Guzzle StreamInterface for use with PHP stream functions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the 'guzzle' stream wrapper if it is not already registered.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Initializes the stream wrapper with the stream object from the context when a stream is opened.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the underlying Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the underlying Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached end-of-file.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Returns a detached clone of the stream resource.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns stat information about the stream resource.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Returns stat information about a stream given its URL.
